spanish: Todas las colgaduras del atrio alrededor *son* lino fino retorcido.
grammarChanges: Removed the unmarked "de" that joined סָבִיב (alrededor) to the verbless predicate שֵׁשׁ מָשְׁזָר (fine twisted linen), which had made it read as the hangings standing around the linen.
Supplied the copula *son* in italics to mark the verbless clause, so the hangings of the court, all around, are stated to be fine twisted linen.
readerNote: Supplied copula *son* marks the verbless predicate linking "alrededor" to "lino fino retorcido"; no concept was added beyond what the verbless clause requires.
